base_effect: Gain 20% increased damage for 30.0 seconds after killing an elite pack.
per_rank_scaling: +1.0 second duration per rank.
rank_25_bonus: Gain 15% increased damage versus elites and take 15% reduced damage from elites.
flavour_text: "Few things embolden the spirit like a powerful enemy lying dead at your feet." -Andomiel Chu, Master Gem Cutter of Xiansai.

base_effect: Each attack you make against an enemy increases the damage it takes from your attacks by 0.80%.
per_rank_scaling: +0.01% damage increase per attack per rank.
rank_25_bonus: Gain 25% increased damage against bosses and Rift Guardians.
flavour_text: After the defeat of Malthael, Diadra the Scholar wandered the world. She studied the gem cutters of Xiansai, and brought their secrets back to Westmarch. Bane of the Stricken is the first gem to come out of her Westmarch workshop.

base_effect: Increase damage against enemies under the effects of control-impairing effects by 15.00%.
per_rank_scaling: +0.30% damage per rank.
rank_25_bonus: Gain an aura that reduces the movement speed of enemies within 15 yards by 30%.
flavour_text: Lady Tu de Qing commissioned this gem from the workshops of Xiansai, saying "I prefer my targets asleep or drunk. Barring that, I'll take sluggish."

base_effect: 25.0% chance on killing an enemy to cause an explosion of gold.
per_rank_scaling: +1.5% chance per rank (caps at 100% at rank 50).
rank_25_bonus: Gain 30% increased movement speed for 2 seconds after picking up gold.
flavour_text: "Rumors speak of a greedy Baroness who sends forth minions to collect treasure, equipped with gems to aid in gathering ever more. Boon of the Hoarder is said to be one of these precious gems." -Abd al-Hazir

base_effect: Adds 16,000 Thorns.
per_rank_scaling: +800 Thorns per rank.
rank_25_bonus: Taunt the first enemy hit by your Primary skills for 2 seconds.
flavour_text: This fragment of a gem, called a chip, was discovered in an underground vault by old man Boyarsky, who fashioned it into the beautiful gem it is today. It damages those who would damage its owner, and once inserted into a socket, it will never fall out.

base_effect: Increase the damage of your pets by 15.00%.
per_rank_scaling: +0.30% damage per rank.
rank_25_bonus: Your pets take 90% less damage.
flavour_text: This stone shares its powerful heart with those who serve the bearer.

base_effect: Gain 10.0% non-Physical damage reduction.
per_rank_scaling: +0.5% non-Physical damage reduction per rank (caps at 60% at rank 100).
rank_25_bonus: While below half Life, your resistances to Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, and Arcane are increased by 75%.
flavour_text: Chuanyang of Xiansai designed a gem which would transport magical energies from their target to the workshop of his greatest competitor, Chau Thanh. He created several copies of this gem before he mysteriously disappeared.

base_effect: Monster kills grant +500 experience.
per_rank_scaling: +50 experience per kill per rank.
rank_25_bonus: Level Requirement Set to 1.
flavour_text: This stone twinkles with low level light, inviting its bearer to dream of higher ambitions.

base_effect: Poison all enemies hit for 2000% weapon damage over 10 seconds.
per_rank_scaling: +50% weapon damage over 10 seconds per rank.
rank_25_bonus: All enemies you poison take 10% increased damage from all sources and deal 10% less damage.
flavour_text: The poison mixers of Xiansai tell of a sickly gem cutter named Zhong Yi Rou who would come by their vats and scream "I'll put you all out of work someday! Yes I will!"

base_effect: Gain Swiftness with every attack, increasing your Attack Speed by 1% and Dodge by 0.50% for 4 seconds. This effect stacks up to 15 times.
per_rank_scaling: +0.01% Dodge per stack per rank (caps at 2.0% Dodge per stack at rank 150).
rank_25_bonus: Gain 1% Cooldown Reduction per stack of Swiftness.
flavour_text: "You do not need to be stronger than your enemy, if you are faster of mind and body." -Queen Seondeok

base_effect: Your Cold skills now apply Chill effects and your Chill effects now slow enemy movement speed by an additional 5.0%.
per_rank_scaling: +0.4% additional slow per rank (caps at 25.0% additional slow at rank 50).
rank_25_bonus: Enemies you Chill have a 10% increased chance to be Critically Hit.
flavour_text: Adventurers used to speak fondly of splint mail armor that would freeze their opponents in place. The sickly gemcutter, Zhong Yi Rou, heard these tales and set out to create a gem that could do the same. "I'll make a few modifications all my own, yes I will," she was heard to mutter.

base_effect: Each hit done increases healing received by 1.00% for 5 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times.
per_rank_scaling: +0.02% healing received per stack per rank.
rank_25_bonus: You are immune from control impairing effects.
flavour_text: “Some say this stone derives its power from its owners life force, which is shortened with each use. Well I say any fight I can walk away from is a victory, and tomorrow can take care of itself.” - Famed warrior Lenalas, the day before his death

base_effect: While you have no set bonuses equipped every legendary item you have equipped increases your damage dealt by 3.75% and reduces your damage taken by 2%.
per_rank_scaling: +3.75% damage dealt per legendary item per rank (caps at 375% per legendary at rank 99).
rank_25_bonus: This bonus is doubled for Ancient items.
flavour_text: A Xiansai master forged this gem from other powerful rings hoping to combine their potencies and form a synergy.

base_effect: 15% chance on hit to smite a nearby enemy for 3000% weapon damage as Holy and heal yourself for 3% of your maximum Life.
per_rank_scaling: +60% weapon damage per rank.
rank_25_bonus: Smite a nearby enemy every 3 seconds.
flavour_text: “It was said that once a year, the two lovers would arrive at opposite river banks. A bridge of birds would form so they could touch. When they parted, their tears filled the land. Mirinae is one such tear. The sadness and rage in its core will only affect those close to it.” -Scholar Sojin Hwang

base_effect: Regenerates 10,000 Life per Second.
per_rank_scaling: +1,000 Life per Second per rank.
rank_25_bonus: After not taking damage for 4 seconds, gain an absorb shield for 200% of your total Life per Second.
flavour_text: The gizzard of the molten wildebeest evinced such extraordinary properties when steeped in the correct mixture of alchemical reagents that the animals were hunted to extinction long ago.

base_effect: 35% of all damage taken is instead staggered and dealt to you over 3.00 seconds.
per_rank_scaling: +0.10 seconds stagger duration per rank.
rank_25_bonus: 20% chance on kill to clear all staggered damage.
flavour_text: Precious stones can sometimes be found among the peaks of Ivgorod. The harmonics of these gems, while in combat, are said to forestall death itself.

base_effect: Gain 10.0% melee damage reduction.
per_rank_scaling: +0.5% melee damage reduction per rank (caps at 60% at rank 100).
rank_25_bonus: While below 50% life, you may move through enemies unhindered.
flavour_text: Chau Thanh of Guozhi designed a gem which would transport the pain and suffering of a physical attack to an undisclosed location. When asked about the ultimate destination of this damage, she would simply smile and mutter “Well deserved. Well deserved.”

base_effect: Critical hits cause the enemy to bleed for 2500.0% weapon damage as Physical over 3 seconds.
per_rank_scaling: +50.0% weapon damage over 3 seconds per rank.
rank_25_bonus: Gain Blood Frenzy, granting you 3% increased Attack Speed for each bleeding enemy within 20 yards.
flavour_text: Xiangyi, most beautiful of Xiansai master gem cutters, crafted this gem in honor of a former lover. The angrier she got, the faster she worked, and the gem was ready in no time. Only after she had tested its efficacy was she finally satisfied.

base_effect: Periodically struggle for control, unleashing a ring of Fire that inflicts 12,500% weapon damage to enemies it passes through.
per_rank_scaling: +50% weapon damage per rank.
rank_25_bonus: After gaining a level, your resource costs are removed and cooldowns on skills are reduced by 75% for 30 seconds.
drop_source: The Dark Lord (The Darkening of Tristram anniversary event)
flavour_text: This looks just like it was part of the infamous Red Soulstone. But that's impossible... It was destroyed long ago.

base_effect: Increase the damage of primary skills by 25.00%.
per_rank_scaling: +0.50% damage per rank.
rank_25_bonus: Hits with primary abilities heal you for 4% of your maximum health.
flavour_text: "A simple task performed a thousand times may seem a drudgery, yet the power it creates is immeasurable." - Matriarch Lian Rasmussen

base_effect: Gain 2.00% increased damage for 1.5 seconds when you spend resource on a channeled skill. This effect stacks up to 10 times.
per_rank_scaling: +0.04% damage per stack per rank.
rank_25_bonus: Gain 2% increased Armor for every stack.
flavour_text: "Given enough resources, one is possessed of an absolute and infinite potentiality." -High Priest Baek

base_effect: 15% chance on hit to gain a Wreath of Lightning, dealing 1250.0% weapon damage as Lightning every second to nearby enemies for 3 seconds.
per_rank_scaling: +25.0% weapon damage per second per rank.
rank_25_bonus: While under the effect of the Wreath of Lightning, gain 25% increased movement speed.
flavour_text: The madwoman Arianne believed she could cut a gem that would make for her a hood of lightning. "Lightning," she was heard to mutter "On my head!" Her body was discovered some weeks later, with no hair, clutching this gem.

base_effect: Damage you deal is increased by 4.00% for every 10 yards between you and the enemy hit. Maximum 20.00% increase at 50 yards.
per_rank_scaling: +0.08% per 10 yards (+0.40% max increase at 50 yards) per rank.
rank_25_bonus: 20% chance on hit to Stun the enemy for 1 second.
flavour_text: Legend says this gem was crafted by Zei to torment fleeing enemies. Other legends claim that Zei never existed.

base_effect: This gem cannot be socketed into jewelry. Used exclusively for Caldesann's Despair recipes to augment Ancient items.
per_rank_scaling: None (drops pre-ranked up to rank 125 based on tier achieved in Echoing Nightmare).
rank_25_bonus: None (augment gem only).
drop_source: Echoing Nightmare reward chest (Spoils of the Pale Green)
flavour_text: This fiery gem emerged from the ruined remains of the Petrified Scream. It thrums with the remnants of power left by distant generations of Nephalem.
